title: The Largest Biotech IPO in US Market History: What Parabilis Is Really Teaching Investors
summary: Parabilis Medicines' record-setting US biotech IPO is not a sign that speculative biotech is back. It shows that investors are willing to fund high-risk innovation when the platform, clinical asset, external validation, and capital-market window all line up.
